t132:
A few things worth knowing
before your first word.
t134: For people who want to strengthen their English through words from their own life, games and a structured program. Start from zero or pick a goal like work or travel, matched to your level.
t135: Do I have to install the extension?+
t136: No. The extension lets you save words while browsing in Chrome on a computer. You can also add words in the app and move through the learning programs.
t137: What can I do for free?+
t138: Saving words in the Chrome extension and all the practice games, forever. Courses and the AI teacher are available in a 14-day trial with no credit card, and in paid plans.
t139: How does practice with the AI teacher work?+
t140: You hold a conversation with a teacher powered by artificial intelligence, practice using your words and get feedback. The conversation opens once you have a small base, and the trial includes 15 minutes. This is an AI teacher, not a human one.
t141: How long should I study each day?+
t142: The pace is yours. Pick a daily goal and start with a few short minutes. The aim is a routine that fits your life.
t143: Can I learn other languages too?+
t144: The full learning program is in English. You can save and practice words in about 30 languages.
